content:
Green Card concerns motor third-party liability when travelling outside the Republic of Moldova. It is not insurance for your own car or, by name alone, a breakdown service. Check the vehicle, itinerary countries, period and actual issued document separately. A saved order or initiated payment is not the same as a valid travel certificate.

This article organises checks without invented tariffs or interpreting other states' rules. Confirm actual validity and claims procedures through official sources and insurer documents. Insurance ING Broker SRL is a broker. Application acceptance, issuance and claims decisions are checked with the insurer under applicable conditions.

Start with the complete route, including transit

Record destination and every planned transit country, not just where you stay longest. Changing route can change territory questions. Request confirmation against the real itinerary before departure and keep the response with order details. Do not infer validity from an old internet map.

Present both options if two routes are possible. Mention if the car remains abroad after one family member returns. This article does not establish border authorities' accepted documents or guarantee entry. Insurance checking and travel requirements are separate preparations.

Read vehicle details from documents

Prepare registration records and details of the person or company applying. Compare registration number, identifier and category with the application. For leased or rented vehicles, or a vehicle used by someone other than its owner, request documents for the actual situation. Do not copy an old policy automatically after changes.

A wrong character is not corrected by a driver's verbal explanation. Report differences before use and ask for proper correction. Do not edit the certificate yourself. Recheck the whole corrected version, not only the discussed field, and retain confirmation of which document to use.

Consider a hypothetical company changing cars before departure. The route and employee remain the same, but a certificate for a different vehicle does not automatically transfer. Check actual registration, category and application details. Do not edit files or rely on a verbal explanation.

Plan the period with the return journey

Set estimated departure, transit and return dates. Ask which periods are available for the vehicle and itinerary. Hotel nights alone exclude the journey there and back. A trip that may extend needs a clear question about steps before expiry.

Check actual commencement and end, including displayed times. Payment does not automatically move dates, and a late request does not create retrospective protection. If departure is postponed, ask about available options. Do not promise changes to family or colleagues before issuer confirmation.

Check both official system and received file

The NBM RCA Data portal offers motor insurance information checking. Use its official address and your vehicle details, not services unnecessarily requesting document photos or passwords. Read results by insurance type and period. Domestic RCA checking does not replace checking the Green Card certificate needed for a journey abroad.

Retain the issued document and contract number. If system and file differ, do not select whichever is convenient. Request clarification before leaving. An assumed synchronisation issue is not evidence everything is correct. Record check time and response without publishing identifiers or personal documents online.

Why compare prices using the same details?

A premium is the amount paid for insurance. Use the same vehicle, territory and period. Check whether the displayed amount is preliminary or final for your application. A friend's price is not a universal tariff, and matching names on screens do not prove matching data.

This article provides no fixed price, guaranteed discount or cheapest offer. Ask what explains differences and what will be issued. Keep payment evidence without sharing complete card details. If payment succeeds but no document appears, contact the provider through its official channel. A bank message is not an insurance certificate.

Green Card, CASCO and roadside assistance

Separate third-party liability, damage to your own vehicle and help when immobilised. Their documents and services can differ. Do not assume Green Card includes towing, accommodation, a replacement car or engine repair. Ask separately about each service important to the route.

For CASCO, check its own territory and conditions rather than assuming they match Green Card. For assistance, obtain the contact, procedure and limits. Do not order costly services assuming automatic reimbursement. Ask which approvals the actual contract requires and who may give them. A broker is not the provider performing the intervention.

Company vehicles: who monitors the documents?

Appoint a person to check a company car or fleet before travel. They need the vehicle actually used, not merely the first one listed for the trip. If it changes at the last minute, repeat checks. A certificate for another registration is not suitable simply because both cars share company ownership.

Keep check date, period and clarification contact internally without passwords, card data or unnecessary personal records. The driver should find relevant information when the office contact is unavailable. Organising access does not replace checking validity.

Keep a pending correction distinct from an issued document. A submitted application and bank message do not confirm the correct certificate. Recheck the complete applicable version and separately review CASCO and assistance. Corporate fleet ownership does not establish universal transfer between vehicles. Retain clear status and official responses without passwords or unnecessary personal copies. This example guarantees neither border admission nor compensation.

If an accident occurs abroad

Prioritise safety and competent authorities' directions. Use issuer instructions and relevant official local information for documents and notification. Do not automatically apply a Moldovan accident procedure abroad. This article sets no universal deadline or fault determination.

Keep received documents and communications and ask through official contacts. Do not sign an explanation you do not understand or promise payment for an insurer. Seek translation or legal help when needed. Do not publish images of victims, personal documents or other participants' information in public groups.

Example of preparing a trip

A Moldovan family plans to drive abroad and considers a different return route. Before ordering, they record both routes, the full period and vehicle details. This illustrates preparation, not a real customer or confirmation of certificate validity and entry conditions.

After receipt, they compare certificate and application and use the official checking tool. Separately, they locate existing assistance contacts and check the chosen itinerary. One vague “travel insurance” question becomes distinct checks without implying every service or incident is covered.

Short pre-departure checklist

  • Vehicle records match the certificate.
  • Destination and transit countries were discussed.
  • The period includes the actual itinerary, not only reservations.
  • Issued document and verification do not contradict.
  • Issuer and relevant contacts are retained.
  • CASCO and assistance are checked separately where present.
  • The driver can access documents without one colleague.

Keep information usable on the road

Prepare the current certificate, issuer contacts and instructions. Check the actual driver can find them without a colleague's personal account. Do not circulate identically named files with different dates. For work travel, identify an out-of-hours clarification contact. Organisation prevents confusion between offers, drafts and issued records without guaranteeing services.

A short trip record can identify the actual vehicle, dates, main and alternative routes, with the source and status of each answer. Keep the issuer's response, official verification and payment message distinct: they serve different purposes. Maintain one clearly identified current document for the driver rather than indistinguishable drafts. Do not change the original file yourself. Recheck the whole corrected certificate and clarify possible delays before expiry. These administrative steps do not establish a universal amendment procedure or guarantee border entry.

If the route changes after purchase

An unexpired policy does not automatically accept a new destination. Review the full route and territory using actual documents and competent sources. Keep the answer. Green Card, assistance and travel records may be affected separately; one confirmation does not replace the others. This is administration, not route or border advice.

Frequently asked questions about Green Card

Can payment prove the policy is issued?

Do not confuse a transaction confirmation with the issued document. Check certificate, details and period. Resolve missing documents or discrepancies officially before use.

Does Green Card repair my car?

Do not treat it as CASCO. Your vehicle and intervention costs require separate questions against the documents and services actually contracted.

What if I change the route?

Recheck territory and period before changing it. The same final destination does not establish a new transit route is included.

Where can insurance information be checked?

Consult official NBM RCA Data and issuer documents. For Green Card questions, also use public BNAA information rather than unverified posts.
